hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -q "gh pr merge" || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git fetch --prune --quiet 2>/dev/null; d=""; for b in $(git for-each-ref --format="%(refname:short)" --merged main refs/heads/ 2>/dev/null | grep -vxF main); do git branch -d "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 && d="$d $b"; done; [ -n "$d" ] && printf '{"systemMessage":"Auto-cleaned merged branches:%s"}\n' "$d"; exit 0
